newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Tuesday 100,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Tuesday 100,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog receipts Tuesday were 100,000 head, compared with 112,000 a week ago and 97,000 a year ago, USDA said. Estimates include generally about 65 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts were steady to $0.50 per cwt lower than the midsession Monday. Trade was slow to moderate for light to moderate demand and offerings.
Sows: uneven, generally steady to 2.00 higher

Note: Prices quoted represent sales of hogs averaging 73-74 pct. carcass yields with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct. lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
